authorization.scope: One new local-only raw-data pass, continuous series and indicator-specific source admission; no indicator feature values, fit, TEST, economics or native changes.

gc_plan.rule: Use and reverify the exact MBP-1 file/receipt SHA-256 bindings from this frozen spec.

method.contract_choice: At 00:01 UTC use largest observed valid T-record contract volume from previous complete UTC day. Initial missing/tied volumes mean no initial choice. Later ties/no-trade days retain prior identity and basis. Never roll backward in maturity. No same-day-volume choice, no substitution on missing current data. Candidate universe is the fixed 15 downloaded outrights, not all GC contracts.
method.volume_source: Raw MBP-1 only. T is trade, F is passive. Integer counts; exclude invalid trades, snapshots, unreliable receive clocks from volume. Unknown aggressors count in total volume separately.
method.initialization: MBP-1 starts 2024-05-01. No April intraday volume exists in this pass; first UTC day is unselected, not warmed with future daily OHLCV. OHLCV-1d is not used: UTC aggregation is documented but historical publication/version timestamps are unproven.
method.metadata: Hash reverify 23 downloaded definition files and receipts. Require unique identity, maturity and tick size per outright across all definitions. These immutable instrument attributes are not a changing as-of signal.
method.masks: Exact pre-TEST OANDA M1 time column only; decision=start+60s strictly before TEST. One selected raw contract per minute. Volume/profile require positive observed valid trades and zero invalid trade, gap, bad-clock-trade or snapshot-trade count in the minute. Footprint/delta/relative CVD additionally require zero unknown-aggressor volume. Missing or event-silent rows are invalid, not zero flow. Repeated consecutive T signatures (ts_recv, ts_event, sequence, action, side, price, size, flags) invalidate that minute; no inferred de-duplication or trade identity claim.
method.admission: Separate ADMIT/REJECT. ADMIT only for masked observed-record inputs, at least one valid minute in each fixed 26 study months and zero unreliable-ts_recv Trade anywhere in a file potentially used by selected contracts. Clock errors are not localized with guessed padding. Every mask and coverage count is retained even after REJECT. No coverage-percent tolerance is fitted.
method.state: Profile/CVD construction remains closed until admission. Candidate relative state must reset on UTC date, contract switch, invalid/silent minute; never blend contracts or backadjust prices. UTC-day segments are not complete exchange sessions.
method.sweeps: REJECT multi-level/individual-order sweeps: MBP-1 contains only BBO depth. A price-sweep proxy is a separate formula, not admitted here.
method.order_blocks: REJECT institutional order-block truth. Price structure with volume support may later extend existing SMC owner using a frozen causal formula; no inferred hidden orders.
method.m5_coverage: Also report complete five-minute input windows requiring all five eligible M1 masks and the same selected contract. Native dataset row mapping/parity is not proven by this audit.

interpretation.evidence: real source bytes; structural suitability only
